d: After nine consecutive challenge losses, Vavau's morale is at an all time low. Tired, hungry and defeated, they have just 3 members left - Kristie, Kate and Conner. They're a dejected tribe, fearful of losing yet another member.
Fia Fia return to camp after their first tribal council. Connor was the first member of the newly formed tribe to be voted out. Kate is upset and she is convinced she is next to go.

In a storm of division, tribal council saw Kate heading home, much to the pleasure of the girls and to the disappointment of Sam.  Sam had spearheaded a campaign to get rid of Nick “the snake”, breaking ranks with this tight alliance.

At Tribal Council and before being voted off the island, Nick has outed the secret alliances that exist at Fia Fia.  There's the larger alliance of five - Sam, Lee, El, Brooke and Flick, but within that, it's the 3 girls that hold all the power.

The blind side at Tribal Council that saw Kylie voted off the island has highlighted the core alliance's strong hold over the game. Within the large five alliance of El, Brooke, Flick, Sam and Lee sits the power trio of Brooke, Flick and El, and their power over the game is becoming unbearable to some.

Last night the core alliance decided it was time to say sayonara to Sue, after an explosive tribal council.  JL dropped bombshell after bombshell in a bold attempt to shake up the game and back at camp she now realises she needs a miracle to survive.

JL's parting words at tribal council tonight have ruffled feathers, and Flick is especially concerned about the suggestion she's on the outer. This prompts her to consider how she can move forward in the game.
